fullPassage: In an experiment conducted by researchers at the University of California, Los Angeles, study subjects were required to give a series of unplanned speeches in front of an audience (a reliable way to trigger anxiety). Half of the participants were then asked to engage in what the researchers call "affect labeling," filling in responses to the prompt "I feel ______," while the other half were asked to complete a neutral shape-matching task. The affect-labeling group showed steep declines in heart rate and skin conductance compared to the control group, whose levels of physiological arousal remained high. Brain-scanning studies offer further evidence of the calming effect of affect labeling: simply naming what is felt reduces activity in the amygdala, the brain structure involved in processing fear and other strong emotions. Meanwhile, thinking in a more involved way about feelings and the experiences that evoked them actually produces greater activity in the amygdala.

✅ ② completing — 원문은 to complete. 'were asked to complete'에서 be asked to + 동사원형 구문. completing으로 바꾸면 어법 오류 ←정답
❌ ③ remained — 동사, levels remained high. 적절
❌ ④ involved — 과거분사, brain structure를 후치 수식. 적절
det.tip: be asked to + 동사원형. were asked to complete(O) / were asked completing(X)

questions.passage: In an experiment conducted by researchers at the University of California, Los Angeles, study subjects were required to give a series of unplanned speeches in front of an audience (a reliable way to trigger anxiety). Half of the participants were then asked to engage in what the researchers call "affect labeling," filling in responses to the prompt "I feel ______," while the other half were asked to complete a neutral shape-matching task. The affect-labeling group showed steep declines in heart rate and skin conductance compared to the control group, whose levels of physiological arousal remained high. Brain-scanning studies offer further evidence of the calming effect of affect labeling: simply naming what is felt reduces activity in the amygdala, the brain structure involved in processing fear and other strong emotions. Meanwhile, thinking in a more involved way about feelings and the experiences that evoked them actually produces greater activity in the amygdala.
questions.stem: 위 글에서 감정 명명 집단이 통제 집단에 비해 급격한 감소를 보인 두 가지 생리적 지표를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (5단어, 영어로)

det.korean: heart rate and skin conductance = 심박수와 피부전도도
det.analysis: 본문 'steep declines in heart rate and skin conductance'에서 두 가지 생리적 지표 = heart rate(심박수) + skin conductance(피부전도도)
det.tip: heart rate(심박수), skin conductance(피부전도도) — 감정 명명 집단의 감소 지표
